chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Shu'ayb, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'The wearing of new shoes is a protection for the body and an aid to prayer and purity.'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of wearing new shoes in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of Al-Kulayni’s Al-Kafi, highlights the Prophetic tradition of wearing new sandals (istijad al-hidha') as a means of physical protection and spiritual readiness. It underscores the Shia emphasis on the interconnection between bodily cleanliness and ritual purity (tahur), framing practical hygiene as an act of worship that facilitates devotion (salat).
